recipes.name: Vegan "Egg" Salad Sandwich
instructions: Finely chop the pressed tofu into very small pieces. Transfer to a large bowl and mix together with the mayonnaise, nutritional yeast, chives, mustard, curry powder, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Assemble the sandwiches by adding a layer of lettuce, sliced cucumber, and a generous layer of "egg" salad on top of the bread.
Cut in half if desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Kala namak, is a salt often used in South Asian cuisine. The sulphur compounds give the salt an egg-like smell and flavour.
Storage The assembled sandwiches are best when enjoyed on the same day. The "egg" salad can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
